files.description: Path → UTF-8 text. `SKILL.md` is required; at most 64 files, 262144 bytes each and 786432 in all.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: Fields for the Agent's loader (e.g. preloaded files, host calls), stored and returned as given.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the Skill is for, kept with this version.

source.description: Where the files came from, when published from a repository.

id.title: Id
id.description: The version's id; content made with it records this id.

skill_id.title: Skill Id
skill_id.description: The Skill it is a version of.

version.title: Version
version.description: 1 for the first version, then one more per new version.

note.title: Note
note.description: What this version changes, as registered.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.description: The fields for the Agent's loader registered with it, as given.

files.title: Files
files.description: Its files, by path, each with a download URL.

download_url_expires_at.title: Download Url Expires At
download_url_expires_at.description: When the files' download URLs stop working: an hour after this response.

base_id.title: Base Id
base_id.description: The version this one was edited from.

batch_id.title: Batch Id
batch_id.description: The Batch it was made in; null when none.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Where it comes from, by type and then target id.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: The assets `data` or `relationships` refer to, with download URLs.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Skill versions in `data` or `relationships`, keyed by version id.

text.title: Text
text.description: How a Script is shot: casting, locations, timed shots and each clip's references, encoded by the SDK (`nuva.storyboard`). It is `based_on` its Script and the Characters it casts.

external_user_id.title: External User Id
external_user_id.description: The user's id in the customer's own system. The first token for an id creates the user; later tokens for the same id identify the same user.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Request a new token before this time.

user.description: The user the token is for.

id.title: Id
id.description: Nuva's id for the user; the `sub` claim of the token.

external_user_id.title: External User Id
external_user_id.description: The user's id in your system, as you sent it.

upload_url.title: Upload Url
upload_url.description: PUT the file's bytes here, before expires_at.

upload_token.title: Upload Token
upload_token.description: Send to POST /v1/assets after the PUT succeeds.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: When `upload_url` and `upload_token` stop working: an hour after the request.

max_bytes.title: Max Bytes
max_bytes.description: The largest file of this kind, in bytes; a larger one is refused when registered (413 ASSET_TOO_LARGE).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What you will upload: `image` (JPEG, PNG or WebP), `video` (MP4) or `audio` (MP3, WAV or MP4).
